metadata.note: Ratings use the same method as the high school ratings: every game, every level, one network. Early seasons and regions that seldom played outsiders (detached or island clusters) rest on few connecting games, so their ratings are less certain; data for many small schools before 1999 is incomplete.

seasons.note: Weakly linked: its group is tied to the rest by 2 games
Detached region: played no one outside its group that season
